title: Why I'm Switching From Claude Back to ChatGPT
description:
Follow me for free AI tutorials daily 👇

I've used Claude Code for over a year and made some of the earliest tutorials about it. I'm not paid by an AI company, so I switch when another tool helps me work faster or earn more.

Codex has a smoother in-app browser. ChatGPT puts scheduled tasks and trigger-based workflows in one place. Its built-in image generation is stronger. Fast mode runs at 1.5x speed when I want to save time.

Migrating from Claude is simple too. Use an import tool or follow the setup instructions.

Which AI tool helps you get the most work done?
Is Codex better than Claude Code?
How do you move from Claude to ChatGPT?

#ai #aitools #chatgpt #claude #productivity
